article.info_title: IndexNow: When and How Websites Should Notify Search Engines
article.info_description: Leaving your content's visibility in search engines to chance is like throwing a party and forgetting to send out the invitations! Learn when and how to update IndexNow to make sure your content gets the spotlight it deserves and stays visible in search results when it matters most.

      interesting content online.

Over the recent years, AVIF has become one of the most commonly used image formats on the web.
        We're happy to announce that AVIF is now a supported file type
        in Google Search, for Google Images as well as any place that uses images in Google Search. You
        don't need to do anything special to have your AVIF files indexed by Google.

article.info_title: Strengthen Your First-Party Data Strategy with New Tools
article.info_description: Building a robust first-party data strategy has never been more critical than in today’s changing digital privacy landscape. As privacy regulations evolve and technologies shift, we’ve continued to build tools that help advertisers succeed while respecting consumer choice. Our updates to the consent mode API earlier this year added two new parameters that provide more control for consent collection. We've added a new 'Set consent mode override' setting to the Google tag settings that lets you override the default consent settings in your website or app code and instead set the default to 'denied' for all regions you choose.
